question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

No sooner had I reached the stop **when the bus left.**
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The highlighted part of the sentence "when the bus left" is incorrect because it does not follow the appropriate structure for "No sooner..." clauses.
 
• The correct structure is "No sooner... than" to indicate two events happening immediately after each other.
 
• Thus, "than the bus left" is the appropriate replacement to ensure grammatical accuracy.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"No sooner had I reached the stop than the bus left."*
